summary.text: Mark Remmert is the Democratic candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican incumbent Duane Droge.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he cited his service as president of the board of trustees of Flint Hills Technical College and his business career.

paragraphs.text: Mark Remmert earned a high school diploma from Olathe High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Wyoming in 1980, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he spent decades in senior leadership at The Dow Chemical Company, was CEO of Styron Inc., and co-founded and led Green Dot Bioplastics.

Remmert said in the survey that his priorities are steady incomes, healthy families and strong schools, and he named education, rural health care, and rural innovation and economic development as areas of policy interest.
